authority: Logistinfra selects transitions and validates receipts; workers do not own canonical truth.

selectorContract.resolution: transition selector order -> lowest costRank -> highest qualityRank -> stable ref
selectorContract.approval: resolved adapter authority is checked after resolution
selectorContract.settlement: tool success never settles; fresh verification is required

workers.defaultUse: high-value ambiguous work, cross-app orchestration, final synthesis
bounded implementation, repo-scale reconstruction, adversarial code review
high-volume low-risk preprocessing and cheap parallel candidate generation
large-context corpus passes, multimodal review, independent ecosystem audit
workers.avoid: replacing deterministic scoring already present in Logistinfra/CogniTime

workers.defaultUse: compile already-routed transitions into bounded execution blocks and score the session
workers.avoid: inventing priorities, market choices, or truth

economicRouting.rule: CogniTime consumes routed transitions; it never creates its own portfolio
use bounded code worker, then CI/fresh state as verifier
use long-context worker, preserve source refs
use high-reasoning worker; external writes still go through surface adapters and approval

revenueInvariant: Every substantial loop must end in SENT, RESPONDED, USED, REVIEWED, REJECTED, INTERVIEW, MERGED, REFERRED, PAID, KILLED, or a verified capability gain/falsified hypothesis.
